title: Scheduled First Quarter 2026 Publication Date
summary: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. (LATAM or the Company) (SSE: LTM / NYSE: LTM) along with its consolidated affiliates (LATAM group), the leading airline group in Latin America, announces that it will release its financial results for the first quarter 2026 on May 5, 2026, following the market close. The release will be available on the Companys Investor Relations website: ir.latam.com . The Company will hold a conference call to discuss the first quarter 2026 financial results on May 6, 2026, at 8:00 am ET / Santiago. Adhering to good corporate governance practices, the Company will begin its quiet period on April 21, 2026, ending immediately after the release of the financial results on May 5, 2026.
